label: Requirement-to-pattern-mechanism inference
definition: Judge questions inferring a specific architectural mechanism from a functional goal or quality constraint.
interpretation_status: Post-hoc analyst interpretation of judge text, not independent adjudication

label: Task variety versus composable pipeline
definition: Judge distinguishes a list of operations from chained, modular, replaceable processing stages.
interpretation_status: Post-hoc analyst interpretation of judge text, not independent adjudication

label: Related concern or scope is not identical intent
definition: Judge distinguishes traceability, content scope, isolation, workflow, or product testability from the particular pattern concern.
interpretation_status: Post-hoc analyst interpretation of judge text, not independent adjudication

label: ML or domain-framing transfer
definition: Judge questions unstated ML, uncertainty, security, or ML-release assumptions; such framing alone does not prove non-support across domains.
interpretation_status: Post-hoc analyst interpretation of judge text, not independent adjudication

label: Rationale or criterion coverage
definition: Judge criticizes unexplained evidence mappings or omitted criteria. Citation of every criterion is not a protocol requirement.
interpretation_status: Post-hoc analyst interpretation of judge text, not independent adjudication

label: Dependency versus interaction contract
definition: Judge distinguishes causal dependency/shared context from blocking, client initiation, or concurrent access.
interpretation_status: Post-hoc analyst interpretation of judge text, not independent adjudication

label: Alternative-design or necessity argument alongside a specific concern
definition: The rationale invokes another possible design or asks why the mechanism is needed. Alternatives alone are not evidential defects; this flag marks mixed reasoning, not a revised verdict.
interpretation_status: Post-hoc analyst interpretation of judge text, not independent adjudication
